capabilities: Merge history from local snapshots, File recovery, and Obsidian Sync
Browse versions in a sidebar history panel with diff stats
Restore a file to a selected version
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not local-only: it also surfaces history from File recovery and Obsidian Sync.
extras: README is written in Japanese. Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later; Sync and File recovery sources only work when those features are enabled.
intentEvidence: ファイルリカバリー | Obsidian 組み込みのファイルリカバリープラグインのデータ
problem: Obsidian offers no unified view of a note's past versions across its own snapshots, File recovery data, and Sync version history.

relations.evidence: Obsidian 組み込みのファイルリカバリープラグインのデータ

summary: Version-history plugin that auto-snapshots notes, shows diffs, and merges local, File recovery, and Obsidian Sync history in one panel.
